cns-20261016/D09-p03.basis: R and Python draw separate per-group summaries and observation marks without cross-group links. Supply independent observations and externally computed statistics; example display estimates do not establish source independence.

cns-20261016/D13-p02.basis: Both adapters draw per-group observation marks with supplied means and SD intervals, without connecting observations across groups. Compute summaries from independent input units.

cns-20261016/D06-p08.basis: Both adapters draw condition-coded observation marks and supplied intervals without matched-unit lines. Supply independent input units and their valid summaries.

cns-20261016/D17-p05.basis: Both adapters keep separate group survival step curves and censor ticks within each panel. Supply curves fitted upstream for independent cohorts; the adapter does not infer independence or fit survival models.

cns-20261021/P034-F4-p8-J.basis: Both adapters draw per-facet group points and supplied intervals, with no unit IDs or matched connections. Paired in the chart title refers to facets, not paired experimental units.

cns-20261021/D33-p05.basis: Both adapters draw per-cancer supplied box summaries and unconnected observation marks. Supply independent input units and recompute the summaries upstream.

cns-20261021/D11-p07.basis: Both adapters draw facet-by-group supplied boxes and unconnected points. Supply independent input units and their valid group summaries.

cns-20261021/P033-F1-p4-G.basis: Both adapters draw group-specific supplied violin profiles, box summaries and unconnected observation marks. Compute these profiles from independent input units.

cns-20261021/P018-F5-p11-C.basis: Both adapters connect category endpoints within sample. Each replacement sample ID must identify the same experimental unit across conditions; source example IDs are display keys.

cns-20261021/P018-F5-p11-D.basis: Both adapters connect condition endpoints within series_id. Each replacement series_id must identify the same experimental unit across conditions; compute paired inference upstream.

cns-20261021/P126-F7-p9-IJ.basis: The composite contains independent group marks in panel I and matched endpoint segments in panel J. Paired tables retain link_id with value_a/value_b; supply the mixed design and real unit links.

cns-20261021/P022-F4-p9-C.basis: Both adapters connect numeric days within trace_key and genotype/treatment. Replacement trace_key values must identify repeatedly measured experimental units; image-derived example traces do not establish biological replication.

cns-20261021/P022-F5-p10-B.basis: Both adapters connect numeric days within series_id and treatment group. Replacement series_id values must identify repeatedly measured experimental units; compute repeated-measure inference upstream.

cns-manual-20261025/P095-F2-a.basis: Displays chromosome-ordered GWAS positions and supplied significance values.

cns-manual-20261025/P044-F4-D.basis: Displays supplied ROC and precision-recall curve coordinates and summary annotations.

cns-corrected-20261025/P081-F4-d.basis: Displays gene-by-cluster expression values with linked annotation strips.

cns-corrected-20261025/P091-F2-e.basis: Displays relative spectral intensity across mass-to-charge positions, with supplied ion annotations.

cns-corrected-20261025/P091-F3-d.basis: Displays supplied enhancer ranks and H3K27ac signals; side-by-side plots do not establish paired experimental units.

cns-corrected-20261025/P091-F3-m.basis: Displays supplied signal profiles, loci and feature coordinates across genomic intervals.

cns-corrected-20261025/P021-F5-b.basis: Displays supplied embedding coordinates colored by feature expression.

cns-corrected-20261025/P028-S2-A.basis: Displays supplied quality scores against a resolution parameter; it is not a time series.

cns-corrected-20261025/P098-F5-k.basis: Displays normalized fluorescence along supplied position coordinates.

cns-corrected-20261025/P112-F5-k.basis: Displays visible group marks and supplied mean/interval summaries; experimental independence is unreviewed.

cns-corrected-20261025/P112-F5-c.basis: Displays visible group marks and supplied five-number summaries; experimental independence is unreviewed.
